title: C4R Car Rental Platform
summary: A complete rental experience, from validated hourly pricing to secure booking management and a paginated admin dashboard.
body:
Built with Next.js App Router and an Express REST API, C4R connects the customer booking experience to car, user, and promotion management.

Hourly and daily pricing calculators use Zod validation. JWT authentication, Helmet, XSS protection, and Mongo sanitization protect the backend.

Server-side rendering and JSON-LD supported a 95+ Lighthouse SEO score. The application runs on Vercel with optimized serverless functions.
stack: Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS

title: Apex Athletics
summary: Multi-vendor commerce with atomic inventory operations, verified Stripe Connect payments, and 73+ automated tests.
body:
Architected a decoupled Next.js and Express marketplace with vendor roles and JWT authentication through HttpOnly cookies.

Atomic MongoDB operations preserve inventory consistency under concurrent usage. Redis caches high-traffic reads, while BullMQ handles background jobs and Resend notifications.

Stripe Connect destination charges automate vendor payouts. Webhook verification and idempotency protect transaction handling.

A suite of 73+ tests spans unit, integration, system, and security layers. It uncovered an XSS vulnerability that was fixed. GitHub Actions supports continuous integration. The administration dashboard covers moderation, vendor onboarding, users, and analytics.
stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, Redis, Stripe

title: Khaleeji-Bot
summary: An automated booking and notification platform combining browser automation, background queues, and external webhook integrations.
body:
Built a React and Node.js platform integrating headless browser automation with Salla and Prometric workflows.

BullMQ and Redis coordinate background jobs; Puppeteer handles browser automation. Helmet, rate limiting, bcrypt, JWT, and Joi input validation protect the API.

Sentry tracks frontend and backend errors. Swagger UI documents the API. The backend runs on Render and the frontend on Cloudflare Pages, with automatic deployment on push.
stack: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ, Puppeteer

title: RankBoost
summary: A bilingual SEO SaaS for keyword and competitor tracking, with scheduled data collection and subscription billing.
body:
Built ranking data collection with Playwright and Browserbase, with daily updates automated through Cron jobs.

The Next.js dashboard supports English and Arabic with full RTL layouts. HttpOnly JWT sessions protect account access.

Stripe subscriptions and webhook-based billing automate the subscription lifecycle. A Stripe Customer Portal supports self-service, while a guided onboarding tour and toast notifications help users navigate the product.
stack: Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Stripe, Playwright
